results.prose: Random spec draw: web-console/architecture.spec.md. The console runtime is unreachable from this sandbox (console host not in egress policy — the standing blocker), so I verified the architecture spec's statically checkable requirements against the source tree. React Router is configured ssr:false (client-rendered SPA per WEB-ARCH-01); internal packages bind through the workspace: protocol and packageManager pins an exact pnpm version (WEB-PKG-01). My one automated FAIL was my own over-strict check: a lone package-lock.json exists, but it's under prefetch/pnpm — the isolated bootstrap manifest the spec EXPLICITLY exempts from the single-workspace rule. Reading the spec before asserting matters; all four requirements actually hold.
results.steps: Read react-router/vite configs for ssr:false; enumerate lockfiles at repo root and nested; parse web-console package.json for workspace: deps; check root package.json packageManager pin.
